name: paperclip
description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
one_liner: A dashboard for running a 'company' made of AI agents — you set goals and a budget, and it assigns the work to bots that act like a CEO, engineers, and marketers.
buyer: A solo founder or very small startup who wants to run parts of their business with a 'team' of AI agents instead of hiring, and needs one place to track their work, cost, and permissions.
business_use_cases: A solo founder runs a 'CEO' and 'marketer' agent pair to draft and execute a go-to-market plan while they focus on the product.
An agency runs client deliverables through a roster of agent 'employees' and uses the dashboard to track hours and cost per client.
A startup uses the budget and governance controls to cap how much an autonomous agent team can spend before a human has to approve more.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted cloud version (already teased via its own waitlist) so non-technical founders don't have to self-host.
A marketplace of pre-built 'org chart' templates, such as a full marketing team, sold as paid templates.

steal_this: Stand up one narrow 'department' — just a customer-support agent team — on top of it for a specific niche business, and sell that as a managed service rather than the whole platform.
